concepts.name: SigNoz Observability Stack
concepts.summary: Deployment configuration for the SigNoz observability stack (Helm values in three revisions: original, current, backup) plus the ingress that exposes it. Pure configuration repo — the SigNoz software itself is upstream.

concepts.name: Service Monitors
concepts.summary: Monitoring scripts that feed SigNoz: monitor-services.py / monitor-to-signoz.py push service states, monitor-matrix.sh watches the Matrix stack, service-health-exporter.py exposes health metrics.

flows.name: Metrics Ingestion
flows.summary: Monitor scripts probe the platform services → monitor-to-signoz.py forwards results into SigNoz → dashboards and alerts run on the ingested data.
